name: AddCommentIcon
description: Add a comment: CommentIcon at 24, its bubble cut short of a plus in the bottom-right corner.

name: FollowArtifactIcon
description: Follow an Artifact: ArtifactIcon's page with a plus in the bottom-right corner. The page's right and bottom edges stop 1.6 short of the plus, and the `< >` sits 1.5 higher so its point clears it by as much.

name: FollowThreadIcon
description: Follow a thread: a plus inside ThreadIcon's front bubble.

name: JoinChannelIcon
description: Join a public channel: Lucide's hash, cut short of a plus in the bottom-right corner.

name: JoinJointChannelIcon
description: Join a joint channel: Lucide's git-branch, with a plus in its empty bottom-right corner.

name: JoinPrivateChannelIcon
description: Join a private channel: Lucide's lock, its body cut short of a plus in the bottom-right corner.

name: LeaveChannelIcon
description: Leave a public channel: the same cut hash, with a minus.

name: LeaveJointChannelIcon
description: Leave a joint channel: Lucide's git-branch, with a minus.

name: LeavePrivateChannelIcon
description: Leave a private channel: the same cut lock, with a minus.

name: ReopenTaskIcon
description: Reopen a task: a ticked box, broken open at the top by a counter-clockwise arrow (Lucide's rotate-ccw-square with a check).

name: UnfollowArtifactIcon
description: Unfollow an Artifact: the same cut page, with a minus. Below 18px the minus is drawn heavier (stroke 3, on whole pixels at 16px), so it reads as a mark beside the page's cut edges rather than one more piece of the outline; at 20 and 24 it is the plain minus.

name: UnfollowThreadIcon
description: Unfollow a thread: a minus inside ThreadIcon's front bubble.

name: ChatIcon
description: A chat: the same plain speech bubble as MessageIcon. Raft draws no difference between a message and a chat (stdrc and Artea, 2026-10-30).

name: CommentIcon
description: A comment, said about a passage: MessageIcon's bubble with quote marks.

name: FeedbackIcon
description: Feedback, sent to the people who make Raft: MessageIcon's bubble with an exclamation mark.

name: ArtifactIcon
description: An Artifact: Lucide's file-code with its page drawn 2 wider (x 3 to 21, not 4 to 20), a page with a folded corner and a `< >`. Lucide's portrait page is 16 wide where the icons beside it (a monitor, people, a speech bubble) are 20, so beside them it read a size smaller; at 18 wide and the same height it reads as their size. An HTML Artifact's chip in a message shows this icon too, so every place shows one page for an Artifact.
